offence_note: Theft and mischief of ballot box from polling station
sentence_quote: I find a fit and appropriate sentence on each charge is a 120-day period of custody, concurrent to each other, and consecutive to anything else, followed by a three- year period of probation.
note: Concurrent 120 days on each count; no remorse; repeat offender.

offence_note: Assault, uttering threats, breach of no-contact order
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal, set aside the sentence imposed by Judge Fratkin and substitute a sentence of one month in custody on Count 1, assault contrary to s. 266 of the Criminal Code;
note: Same global ten months, restructured and credit allocated to avoid immigration consequences; probation from trial presumably stands.

sentence_quote: on Count #1 you will do two months in jail; Count #2 you will do two months consecutive months, for a total of four months custody.
note: Conditional sentence rejected; no victim surcharge.

offence_note: Kidnapping, robbery, unlawful confinement, assault causing bodily harm
sentence_quote: a fit sentence in relation to Count 2, which is the kidnapping count, is a sentence of four years, six months, less time served equivalent to one year and two months, for a total sentence of three years and four months imprisonment.
note: Co-accused Skerrat-Guyot tried separately apparently; other counts concurrent (2y, 2y, 12m).

offence_note: Possession of loaded handgun and shotgun; breach of recognizance (youth)
sentence_quote: We would substitute a concurrent probationary sentence of 12 months from April 27, 2018, imposing the same terms and conditions as those imposed by the youth court judge on April 27, 2018.
note: Probation on s.95 count cut to 12 months; 15 months on others; 7-year weapons prohibition upheld.

sentence_quote: Taken together, these factors easily support the one year sentence imposed by the trial judge.
note: Driving prohibition not mentioned; recorded as unstated.

offence_note: Nine counts theft over $5,000 from client trust funds by lawyer
sentence_quote: the five year term of imprisonment imposed on the appellant is within an acceptable range and ought not to be disturbed.
note: Restitution reduced on appeal from $196,094.15 to $182,425.99; sentence is ten/five-month consecutive terms.

offence_note: Trafficking cocaine and methamphetamine; possession of proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: We would substitute a sentence of 16 months in prison.
systemic_quote: the sentencing judge referred to the Gladue factors, the plea of guilt, the respondent's expression of remorse, and the steps he has taken towards rehabilitation. These are all strong mitigating factors
note: Conditional sentence set aside; 16 months prison substituted but stayed, no committal; probation remains.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, stabbing victim in face with knife
sentence_quote: On the count of aggravated assault contrary to s. 268(2) of the Criminal Code, the sentence I have imposed is 874 days.
systemic_quote: Mr. Smith's degree of moral blameworthiness is reduced on account of the s. 718.2(e) factors.
note: Victim surcharge waived; mitigating section not fully shown.
